SPIREBROTHERS-LOGIC.title: Logic
SPIREBROTHERS-HANDS.title: Hands
SPIREBROTHERS-STRATAGEM.title: Stratagem
SPIREBROTHERS-STRATAGEM.description: Can only be played after you enter its input this turn by playing [gold]Logic[/gold] and [gold]Hands[/gold] cards in that order.
SPIREBROTHERS-WIRED.title: Wired
SPIREBROTHERS-WIRED.description: Active if you've already played a card of the other type ([gold]Logic[/gold] or [gold]Hands[/gold]) this turn.
SPIREBROTHERS-SHARE.title: Share
SPIREBROTHERS-SHARE.description: Choose a player. In solo play, it targets you.
SPIREBROTHERS-DILIGENT.title: Diligent
SPIREBROTHERS-DILIGENT.description: This card gets stronger each time you play it this combat.
SPIREBROTHERS-COMEBACK.title: Comeback
SPIREBROTHERS-COMEBACK.description: Deals bonus damage to [gold]Insulted[/gold] enemies, then removes [gold]Insulted[/gold].
SPIREBROTHERS-EXACT.title: Exact
SPIREBROTHERS-EXACT.description: A bonus if you have exactly 0 energy left after paying for this card. X-cost cards always count.
SPIREBROTHERS-HOARD.title: Hoard
SPIREBROTHERS-HOARD.description: Gets stronger the more [gold]Gold[/gold] you're holding.
SPIREBROTHERS-RANT.title: Rant
SPIREBROTHERS-RANT.description: Gets stronger for each Rant card you already played this turn. Whoever has to listen pays the price.
SPIREBROTHERS-DELEGATE.title: Delegate
SPIREBROTHERS-DELEGATE.description: A player's next Attack deals double damage.
SPIREBROTHERS-SONG.title: Song
SPIREBROTHERS-CHORUS.title: Chorus
SPIREBROTHERS-CHORUS.description: Spends ALL your [gold]Verses[/gold] for an effect that grows with each one spent.
SPIREBROTHERS-CHECK.title: Check
SPIREBROTHERS-CHECK.description: Find a random item for a random player: [gold]Filler[/gold] (4 [gold]Block[/gold]), [gold]Useful[/gold] (draw 1 next turn), [gold]Progression[/gold] (1 energy next turn), or a [gold]Trap[/gold] (an enemy gets 1 [gold]Weak[/gold] and 1 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold]).
SPIREBROTHERS-SCRIPT.title: Script
SPIREBROTHERS-SCRIPT.description: At the start of your next turn, this card's effect happens again for free. Write it once, let it run.
SPIREBROTHERS-KIDS.title: Kids
SPIREBROTHERS-KIDS.description: Tim has up to 8. At the end of your turn, each Kid deals 1 damage to a random enemy.
SPIREBROTHERS-AGE.title: Age
SPIREBROTHERS-AGE.description: Tim's Age lasts the whole run. Each Age gives all his cards +1 damage and +1 [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Age Up[/gold] advances it: Dark, Feudal, Castle, then Imperial.
